proof.text: Choose a finite free surjection onto M; its kernel is finite over the Noetherian ring.

Apply the finite-free truncation construction to the kernel and splice its terminal map with the kernel inclusion and the chosen surjection. Exactness follows at the splice from the kernel-image equality and surjectivity, while earlier terms are unchanged.

title: Successor finite free resolution truncation
statement: successor-step truncation statement in the module

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_resolution_data_succ
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (k + 1 + 3),
      S.Exact ∧ IsZero (S.obj' 0) ∧ IsZero (S.obj' (k + 1 + 3)) ∧
      Nonempty ((S.obj' (k + 1 + 2)) ≃ₗ[R] M) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (k + 1),
        Module.Free R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)) ∧
        Module.Finite R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)))
